plan: Drive: from Village of Daajing Giids, about 115 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Oceanview Dr, Hwy 16, Front St, Harrison Ave.
Park: 54.04065, -132.19202, pull off on Raven Ave (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 6.3 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 27 m, about 129 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 190 m E of the spot at 17 m (54.0738, -132.26798). Water: unnamed wetland 50 m W (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-13, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R6C-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-13: about 2,538 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.13 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
